title: Govt halves e2W subsidy, extends PM E-DRIVE to March 2028
summary: PM E-DRIVE extended 1 yr to **31 Mar 2028**; e2W incentive cut ₹5,000/kWh → ₹2,500/kWh; max incentive per e2W now ₹5,000 (was ₹10,000 FY25); eligible e2Ws: ex-f...

items: PM E-DRIVE extended 1 yr to **31 Mar 2028**; e2W incentive cut ₹5,000/kWh → ₹2,500/kWh; max incentive per e2W now ₹5,000 (was ₹10,000 FY25); eligible e2Ws: ex-factory price up to ₹1.5 lakh; total outlay unchanged: ₹11,900 cr.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — Extension date (Mar 2028) + subsidy halved — before/after trap.
